meta.method: All x402 listings on 402index.io (56,839) filtered to Base; up to 2 endpoints per host probed unpaid (6,706) to read payTo from the 402; 1,987 Base payTo wallets; USDC Transfer logs into them over the last 30 days (~1.296M blocks) via eth_getLogs; payments = transfers of $0.000001-$1.00; multi_seller_payers = payer wallets that paid >=20 different sellers (likely directory/test buyers). 397/400 sampled transfers came with an EIP-3009 AuthorizationUsed event (x402 exact scheme).
